timing: Exploratory, specified after prior candidate/source outcomes were known but before matched-background summaries. Not preregistered.
question: Do the fixed descriptive priorities have more negative full-fit effects than reference-stage and control-abundance matched nonpriority genes in each additional context?
frozen_priorities: Original 36, no reselection by new outcomes
universe: Original 9675-gene primary intersection, intersected with source-specific full-fit tested and globally unique symbols. Background excludes only the 36 fixed priorities, not all prior candidates.
covariate: Mean across the three control libraries of the full voom log2-CPM expression. Reconstruct from source integer counts and frozen full-fit library sizes/TMM factors; verify all-six mean against frozen AveExpr. Never match on perturbation abundance or effect.
stage: Exact native peak-group match within each reference; retain its native group names. Require measured, positive peak expression, finite dominance share. Exclude not_measured/unexpressed/tied labels if present.

primary_matching.ordering: distance=absolute abundance difference/caliper + absolute dominance difference/0.2, then symbol lexicographic; never inspect outcomes

eligibility: Retain targets with at least five qualifying controls under both schemes. Within each cohort/reference/caliper, summarize the same target set for both schemes. Always report measured, stage-available, matchable and missing denominators out of 36.
weights: Equal target weights; equal weights among each target neighborhood. A background gene may appear in several neighborhoods, so this is a weighted reference comparison, not independent replicated genes.
endpoints: Equal-target mean logFC of priorities, matched-neighborhood mean logFC and their difference
Priority proportion at most -log2(1.5), mean matched-neighborhood proportion and their difference
Per-target expression/dominance gaps and source stage labels
inference: Deterministic descriptive comparisons only; no gene-based P values, biological independence claims, causal composition adjustment, enrichment FDR or confidence intervals. Full fits only; no inherited background omission stability.
selection_limits: Candidate selection came from earlier primary effects. Sources and references already explored; this is a sensitivity on the selected data, not confirmatory replication. Matching cannot remove unmeasured biology, errors in stage transfer, or within-group stage heterogeneity.

source_audit.target: GSE294151 plus six explicitly linked ENA BioSamples; bounded refreshed source fields and targeted official/publication search
source_audit.scope: Targeted, not exhaustive; no author contact or private access
source_audit.access: Required local proxy, no direct fallback
source_audit.SRA_fallback: After four ENA404 records, count-first query exact six GEO-linked SRX accessions and retrieve numeric UIDs in at most three extra requests; total at most12.

preserve: All old contracts, code and snapshots remain immutable; zero changes to primary hypothesis family.
background_stage_eligibility: Within each reference view both schemes use the same background with a valid measured positive-expression stage annotation. Abundance-only ignores stage and dominance when ranking. Strict scheme additionally requires exact peak group and dominance caliper.
implementation_notes: Caliper comparisons allow numerical tolerance 1e-12, not data-driven threshold changes.

Control covariates use frozen six-library TMM factors. Their contribution is a common additive shift across genes within each cohort, audited to cancel in abundance differences. The source tested universe still comes from the full comparison.
post_hoc_diagnostic_addendum: After the first matched means were inspected, add median paired differences and delete-one-priority mean ranges to inspect gene influence. These are descriptive, not sample omissions, confidence intervals or biological replication.
